method: Read complete appointed source clauses independently of integer labels. The pinned eBible DRA rows are corroborated by the published DRBO Challoner/Douay–Rheims text. The relationships below retain full source rows when a requested Standard verse ends or begins inside that printed row, and require the whole-unit notice when the envelope includes an adjacent Standard unit. Published orthographic variants are retained in their separate witnesses; no wording is replaced by this numeric boundary review.

boundaries.sourceText: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

boundaries.sourceText: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.

boundaries.sourceText: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: Thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie. The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: Thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie. The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor.

boundaries.sourceText: Thou hast subjected all things under his feet, all sheep and oxen: moreover the beasts also of the fields.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Thou hast subjected all things under his feet, all sheep and oxen: moreover the beasts also of the fields.

boundaries.sourceText: He that speaketh truth in his heart, who hath not used deceit in his tongue: Nor hath done evil to his neighbour: nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.
boundaries.boundaryReview: Truth spoken in the heart closes15:2 before tongue/neighbour15:3.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: He that speaketh truth in his heart, who hath not used deceit in his tongue: Nor hath done evil to his neighbour: nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.

boundaries.sourceText: That my mouth may not speak the works of men: for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.
boundaries.boundaryReview: The mouth-not-transgressing conclusion closes17:3 before the works/paths17:4.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: That my mouth may not speak the works of men: for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.

boundaries.sourceText: From them that resist thy right hand keep me, as the apple of thy eye. Protect me under the shadow of thy wings.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: From them that resist thy right hand keep me, as the apple of thy eye. Protect me under the shadow of thy wings.

boundaries.sourceText: He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber, Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way:
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber, Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way:

boundaries.sourceText: And to him my soul shall live: and my seed shall serve him.
boundaries.boundaryReview: The soul/life conclusion belongs to22:29 before seed/serving22:30.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: And to him my soul shall live: and my seed shall serve him.

boundaries.sourceText: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: and the heavens shall shew forth his justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.
boundaries.boundaryReview: The generation clause closes22:30 before declaring righteousness22:31.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: and the heavens shall shew forth his justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.

boundaries.sourceText: Neither let my enemies laugh at me: for none of them that wait on thee shall be confounded.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Neither let my enemies laugh at me: for none of them that wait on thee shall be confounded.

boundaries.sourceText: Let all them be confounded that act unjust things without cause. Shew, O Lord, thy ways to me, and teach me thy paths.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Let all them be confounded that act unjust things without cause. Shew, O Lord, thy ways to me, and teach me thy paths.

boundaries.sourceText: He hath exalted me upon a rock: and now he hath lifted up my head above my enemies. I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.
boundaries.boundaryReview: The high-rock clause closes27:5 before the raised-head/sacrifice27:6.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: He hath exalted me upon a rock: and now he hath lifted up my head above my enemies. I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

boundaries.sourceText: In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

boundaries.sourceText: He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

boundaries.sourceText: In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.

boundaries.sourceText: Can number thy wrath? So make thy right hand known: and men learned in heart, in wisdom.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Can number thy wrath? So make thy right hand known: and men learned in heart, in wisdom.

boundaries.sourceText: His truth shall compass thee with a shield: thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: His truth shall compass thee with a shield: thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

boundaries.sourceText: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: of invasion, or of the noonday devil.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

boundaries.sourceText: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts:
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts:

boundaries.sourceText: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

boundaries.sourceText: Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: serve ye the Lord with gladness. Come in before his presence with exceeding great joy.
boundaries.boundaryReview: Earth-song100:1 and service/coming100:2 are one source row.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: serve ye the Lord with gladness. Come in before his presence with exceeding great joy.

boundaries.sourceText: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.
boundaries.boundaryReview: Redemption107:2 and gathered-countries107:3 begin in one source row; directions107:3 continue in source3.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.

boundaries.sourceText: That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: the works of his hands are truth and judgment.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

boundaries.sourceText: All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, made in truth and equity.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, made in truth and equity.

boundaries.sourceText: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: he shall not fear the evil hearing. His heart is ready to hope in the Lord:
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: he shall not fear the evil hearing. His heart is ready to hope in the Lord:

boundaries.sourceText: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength: the right hand of the Lord hath exulted me: the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.
boundaries.boundaryReview: The mighty right-hand clause closes118:15 before exalted/repeated-right-hand118:16.
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength: the right hand of the Lord hath exulted me: the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.

boundaries.sourceText: Who keepeth truth for ever: who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: who giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth them that are fettered:
boundaries.publishedWitnessExcerpt: Who keepeth truth for ever: who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: who giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth them that are fettered:
